Third-party content shipped under /vendor

anatomy/anatomy.glb
  3D anatomical muscle + skeleton model, derived from Z-Anatomy (https://www.z-anatomy.com/, https://github.com/LluisV/Z-Anatomy-Sample),
  itself based on BodyParts3D (c) The Database Center for Life Science. Preparation (extraction, decimation, group metadata, Draco compression)
  by https://github.com/tiralonghipol/free-muscles (file public/anatomy.glb), which states it is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
  License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
  Any redistributed or modified version of this file must stay CC BY-SA 4.0 and credit Z-Anatomy and BodyParts3D.
  VitaForge does not modify the file; it only colours the named meshes at run time and fits a procedural head around the skull bones.

three/ (three.module.min.js r170, GLTFLoader, DRACOLoader, BufferGeometryUtils, RoomEnvironment)
  three.js, MIT License, (c) 2010-2024 three.js authors, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
  Import specifiers in the example loaders were rewritten to relative paths; no other change.

draco/ (decoder files)
  Draco decoder as shipped with three.js examples, Apache License 2.0 (Draco, (c) Google).

body-viewer.js
  VitaForge's own viewer code.

figure.glb: Mannequin mesh and animation clips (Jog, Sprint, Walk, Jumping Jacks, Pushup) from the Mesh2Motion / Quaternius Universal Animation Library, CC0 1.0 (no attribution required).

Exercise reference photos (public/exercise-media): from the free-exercise-db public dataset (github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db, repo licence Unlicense). Image provenance is not independently verified; accepted as a demo/test-server risk by the owner on 2026-11-16. Replace or remove before any commercial use.
